# Test basic metric comparison scenarios
# Set up a git repository with different metrics on different branches

# Initialize git repo
exec git init
exec git config user.name "Test User"
exec git config user.email "test@example.com"

# Create initial file with 3 todos
exec git checkout -b main
exec git add code.txt
exec git commit -m 'initial commit'

# Create feature branch with 2 todos (improvement)
exec git checkout -b feature
cp code-feature.txt code.txt
exec git add code.txt
exec git commit -m 'removed one todo'

# Test that fewer TODOs passes with less-than comparison
exec ratchet --lt main 'grep -c TODO code.txt'
stdout 'Success: HEAD metric \(2\) is less than main \(3\)'

# Test the reverse (should fail)  
exec git checkout main
! exec ratchet --lt feature 'grep -c TODO code.txt'
stderr 'Failure: HEAD metric \(3\) is NOT less than feature \(2\)'

-- code.txt --
line 1
TODO: fix this
line 3
TODO: improve this
line 5
TODO: optimize this
-- code-feature.txt --
line 1
TODO: fix this
line 3
line 5
TODO: optimize this
